가전과 전장 등 전자제품 사업 비교

methodology.financial_scope: Consolidated statements (CFS) are preferred; standalone (OFS) is queried only when consolidated statements return no records.
methodology.interim_reporting: Half-year flow metrics use six-month cumulative values. Q2 is derived from H1 cumulative less Q1; Q4 is derived from annual less Q1-Q3 only when all component data exist.
methodology.returns: ROA/ROE and asset turnover are not annualized for interim periods.
methodology.roic: Illustrative ROIC uses NOPAT = operating income × (1 - 22% assumed tax rate); this is an analytical assumption, not reported tax guidance.
